title: ProductCredential
description: SSH credential granting ShipIt access to exactly one repository (ADR 0018, AGENTS.md §13a). Holds no key material: the private half lives in the operator's local secret store and is referenced only by referenceName. Status only advances on a proven result at a recorded time.

productId.description: Owning product, for ownership checks. Scope is the repository, not the product.

repositoryId.description: The single repository this credential can reach.

referenceName.description: Name under which the private half is held in the local secret store, e.g. GIT_PRODUCT_<productRef>_SSH. Never the value.

publicKey.description: Public half only. Safe to store, display and copy out.

status.description: No 'assumed working' value exists by design.

lastVerifiedAt.description: When a connection using this credential last succeeded. Absent means never proven.

hostKeyStatus.description: unknown refuses connection; changed fails closed because it is indistinguishable from interception.

hostConfirmedBy.description: Trust-on-first-use is a human decision and is attributable.

supersedesCredentialId.description: The credential this one replaced, when created by rotation.
